title: Deposit Reduction for Comfort Club Dues Payment History, Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
For a special-order part on a call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls, a member's record of paying Comfort Club dues earns a deposit reduction in points off the deposit rate. The records read are the agreement's status under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements and the dues payment entries on its dues ledger, by posting date.

**Rule.** A customer whose active agreement shows two or more dues payments in the last 24 months earns a deposit reduction of 5 points. One with a single dues payment in that time earns 3 points. Any other customer earns no reduction. A payment is within the last 24 months while fewer than 24 whole calendar months have passed from its posting date to the date of handling.

| Active agreement: dues payments in the last 24 months | Deposit reduction |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 5 points |
| Exactly 1 | 3 points |
| None, or no active agreement | None |

## Boundaries

- Two dues payments earn 5 points. One earns 3.
- A payment posted 23 whole months and some days ago counts. One posted 24 whole months ago does not.
